families.label: Digital Products and Platforms
families.definition: Operation and delivery of software products, cloud services, marketplaces, discovery systems, social platforms, and digital advertising infrastructure.

capabilities.label: Software product publishing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to develop, license, distribute, update, and support reusable software products offered to multiple customers or user organizations.

capabilities.label: Cloud computing service delivery
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate and deliver elastic computing, storage, database, platform, or application services through metered or contracted cloud infrastructure.

capabilities.label: Online marketplace operation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate a digital market that enables independent buyers and sellers or providers to discover, transact, fulfill, and govern exchanges.

capabilities.label: Search and discovery platform operation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to index, rank, retrieve, recommend, and present digital information, products, services, or entities through a discovery platform.

capabilities.label: Social media platform operation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate a digital platform for user identity, content creation, sharing, interaction, moderation, discovery, and community participation.

capabilities.label: Digital advertising platform operation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate technology for advertising inventory, audience selection, bidding, delivery, measurement, attribution, safety, and settlement.

families.label: Communications Services
families.definition: Operation and delivery of wireless, wireline, broadband, cable, transmission, and managed communications networks and subscriber services.

capabilities.label: Wireless telecommunications service
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate licensed or managed wireless networks and deliver mobile voice, messaging, data, or connected-device services to subscribers.

capabilities.label: Wireline broadband service
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate fixed communications access networks and deliver broadband, voice, data, or enterprise connectivity services.

capabilities.label: Cable and media network service
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate cable or managed media distribution networks and deliver video, broadband, voice, or related subscriber services.

capabilities.label: Communications network operation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate, monitor, maintain, interconnect, secure, and restore carrier-grade communications and transmission infrastructure.
